ui.title: Multilingual Service Line
ui.tagline: A voice agent for your service line that answers in the caller's language, finds their account, checks known outages, logs requests, and - through an attached wrap-up workflow - books a human callback in the right language when one is needed.

actions.label: Run: Service call wrap-up
actions.description: Run by the service line agent at the end of a call. Kaman summarises the call, decides whether it needs a human callback, books it with the right priority and language, and records the outcome.

inputs.name: transcript
inputs.label: Transcript
inputs.default: Caller (Hindi): My water connection has had no supply since yesterday... Agent: I have logged it... Caller: Please have someone call me, my father is unwell.

actions.label: Ask the Service Desk Agent
actions.description: Logs service requests and books callbacks as Zendesk tickets.

inputs.name: question
inputs.label: Your question
inputs.default: Task: Book an urgent callback in Hindi for +91-90000-00000.
